judge.version: The Silence of the Lambs (1991 film)

gaps.why: Prosecution reads his calm as zero remorse; Defense reads his bond with Clarice as real feeling. The film never shows him regret a single victim.
Defense says he is patient, not thrill-seeking; Prosecution points to his delight in mind games.
Both agree he is charming; they split on whether it is a weapon or just who he is.

result.verdict: A rare full house: schemer, egoist and cold predator at once. His low Short Fuse makes him more frightening, not less: the control is the point.
result.takeaway: Same character, same evidence, a 13-point disagreement.
